name: Projected Interpolation Degree of the Interpolation-Conjecture Counterexample
proof: Projecting $\{001,010,011,100\}$ onto its last two coordinates gives the full two-cube, so the value is at least two. The other two-coordinate projections have at most three distinct traces and interpolation degree one, while the original class and all one-coordinate projections have degree at most one. Thus the maximum is exactly two.
